description: Edit an existing module item in place: rename it, repoint an ExternalUrl/ExternalTool item, reposition or re-indent it, publish/unpublish it, or move it to another module. ExternalUrl items exist only as module items, so a stale link carried in by a course copy can only be fixed here.

external_url.description: New URL for an ExternalUrl or ExternalTool item

module_id.description: The Canvas module ID the item currently belongs to

new_tab.description: Whether an external item opens in a new tab

target_module_id.description: Move the item to this module ID (omit to leave it where it is)

title.description: New title for the module item

name: update_module_item
title: Update Module Item
